# I Ching Insight (天机推演)

> I Ching Insight is personality-first: it treats the 64 hexagrams as a personality system, not a coin-casting oracle.

> I Ching Insight is an AI-era application of the I Ching (易经 / Book of Changes): it derives your birth hexagram (本命卦) from your birth date, maps it to one of the 64 hexagrams as a personality archetype, and offers compatibility matching (易缘匹配 / 合盘) based on hexagram pairs. The site is fully bilingual (Simplified Chinese and English).

## App facts

- Download: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.clawbook.tianji
- Platform: Android (Google Play)
- Pricing: free to start, no signup form required; optional VIP subscription billed monthly or yearly through Google Play (more daily readings, full deep analyses).
- Core calculation: birth date, converted to the lunar calendar, plus an optional two-hour birth period (时辰); when the period is left unset the app defaults to 11:00-13:00.
- English overview page: https://claw-book.cn/i-ching-personality.en.html

## Tools

- Birth hexagram calculator (English): https://claw-book.cn/tianji/gua/?lang=en
- Birth hexagram calculator (中文): https://claw-book.cn/tianji/gua/
